description:
You are a web developer reviewing the error log of a local development web server. The log is located at /home/user/devserver/error.log. Each line in the log has the format: 
[YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS] ERROR: <error message>
For example: 
[2024-05-01 14:23:10] ERROR: File not found: /index.html
Your task is to process this log as follows: 1. Extract only the unique error messages (the part after "ERROR: ") from all the lines in /home/user/devserver/error.log and ignore any duplicate messages. 2. Sort these error messages in alphabetical order. 3. Save them into a new file, /home/user/devserver/unique_errors.txt, where each line contains just the error message, with no timestamps or other text. The resulting unique_errors.txt should: - Have one unique error message per line, sorted alphabetically. - Contain no blank lines, timestamps, or prefixes like "ERROR:". After creating unique_errors.txt, display its contents in the terminal.
